diagram_candidates.kind: Optional TikZ directed-graph and moralization schematic
diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition combines two graph transformations (ancestral closure followed by undirecting and marrying parents). A single small example would make the change in edge set concrete; the written definition is complete and no diagram is required for correctness.
diagram_candidates.concrete_maps_and_relations: Use a DAG with arrows a→c←b and c→d, with S={d}. The ancestral closure is {a,b,c,d}; after undirecting, retain edges a—c, b—c, c—d and add the moral edge a—b because a,b are parents of c. Label the stages G, G[An_G(S)], and mor_G(S), and do not add any edge from a node outside the closure.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional pedagogical candidate, not a defect; current source already states the construction exactly.
